widgets_values:
=== REQUIRED MODELS (Download before use) ===

1. PiD 2K Checkpoint:
   https://huggingface.co/nvidia/PiD/tree/main/checkpoints/PiD_res2k_sr4x_official_flux_distill_4step

2. PiD 2K-to-4K Checkpoint (optional, for 4K):
   https://huggingface.co/nvidia/PiD/tree/main/checkpoints/PiD_res2kto4k_sr4x_official_flux_distill_4step

3. Flux VAE (encoder weights):
   https://huggingface.co/nvidia/PiD/blob/main/checkpoints/ae.safetensors

4. Z-Image / Flux Checkpoint (place in ComfyUI/models/checkpoints):
   Any Flux-compatible model (zimage, flux1-dev, etc.)

5. ComfyUI-PiD Custom Node:
   https://github.com/Merserk/ComfyUI-PiD

Install: cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes &&\ngit clone https://github.com/Merserk/ComfyUI-PiD.git\ncd ComfyUI-PiD && pip install -r requirements.txt

VRAM: ~13GB for 2K output.
Use staged workflow (PiD Prepare -> Sample -> Finalize) for lower VRAM.
nodes.title: Model Downloads & Setup Notes

widgets_values:
=== WORKFLOW CONFIGURATION ===

Base Latent: 512x512
Checkpoint: PiD 2K (2k)
Scale: 4
Final Output: 2048x2048

Settings:
- backbone: zimage (Flux-compatible)
- pid_ckpt_type: 2k
- pid_steps: 4 (4-step distilled)
- scale: 4 (4x upscaling)
- cfg_scale: 1.0
- sigma: 0.0
- auto_download: true (auto-fetch models)
- unload_comfy_before_pid: true
- aggressive_cleanup: true
- sequential_offload: disabled

Tip: For 4K (4096x4096):
- Change base latent to 1024x1024
- Change pid_ckpt_type to 2kto4k
- Keep scale at 4
